The SpaceX–xAI merger (the "SpaceX Super Intelligence" named in the lawsuit) closed in February 2026. Anthropic's $70–$78 IPO range and 19 November listing were covered in the previous briefing; the only in-window update, an amended filing citing $81 billion of run-rate revenue as of 31 October, is noted here rather than repeated.
